The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator choosing the wrong World Bank indicator. At step 5 it sent WebSurfer to NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS, which is "Gross domestic savings (% of GDP)", not "Gross savings (% of GDP)", the indicator the question asks about. All later analysis ran on that wrong dataset, so the final list was wrong. It also still contained regional aggregates, which the Assistant's script did not filter out.
